game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Rope Line, a long fixed rope line: the avalanche scout must handle storm winds while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Frequency Bazaar: Count how often each item appears using a dictionary.
theme: Frost Peaks – Rope Line: a long fixed rope line
core_gameplay_loop: In Rope Line, repeat each round: Count how often each item appears using a dictionary. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the tally value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the rope bridge using at most 23 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The rope bridge reached with actions_used <= 23.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 23 before the rope bridge is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 10 (extended tier): Frequency Bazaar
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Frequency Bazaar' (Week 8 slot 9), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Rope Line'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tally changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against storm winds in Rope Line.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The rope bridge reached with actions_used <= 23.
